size_basis: mixer + grinder + HP drier cabinet at the 0.6 kW duty (A-M-426) (X-FARM sec3)

design.service: ration formulation: duckweed + larvae meal + recycled eggshell; HP drier on the storage draw only
design.basis: A-M-426; A-M-416 (no imported grain); TECHTREE insect-farming (black-soldier-fly meal milling class)
design.fresh_first: fish and ducks eat the harvest wet; drying serves only the A-M-270 dry-reserve draw (0.5 kg/d)
design.methionine: the binding supplement (~9 g/d DL-met equivalent at 4-crew; TECHTREE poultry.chickens: synthetic DL-methionine is the standard supplement class)
design.ca_source: recycled eggshell 38 g Ca/d + BSFL Ca 5-8 % (TECHTREE insect-farming) + mineral CaCO3 top-up ~1.5-2 kg/month from the site mineral line (TECHTREE poultry.chickens: crushed limestone free-choice class)
design.food_safety: larvae meal routes to POULTRY ONLY, never to the fish: manure-fed larvae are the pathogen bridge the aquaponic produce path must not carry (TECHTREE agriculture.aquaponics food-safety note)

nozzles.service: fresh duckweed to formulation (layers + quail + reserve draw)
dried larvae meal to the layer formulation
baked crushed eggshell return (38 g Ca/d)
dried duckweed to the dry reserve
screenings/fines back to the larvae bin
drying evaporation on the storage draw (fresh-basis water)
fresh larvae to the formulation drier
pressed duckweed mash to the duck ration
press water back to the loop

material: SS304 contact surfaces and mixing troughs, PP feed bins, quartz-sleeve drier ducting; no copper-bearing alloys on any feed path
holds: no AQS-PLAN-006 section 4 route class for class feed_prep
